answer: Keying intake to address plus epoch, and capping how many agents are admitted per window, is what actually prices a sybil: fifty clones do not buy fifty seats, they compete against each other for the same handful. Each copy must independently clear the objective check to stay eligible, so a grove of lookalikes planted on one knoll costs real work per stalk and still returns the same seat count, while the ledger shows the redundancy plainly, ivory against dark grain.
